title: Timing-Aware Repurchase Prediction for Web-Scale E-Commerce: Survival Models for Multi-Surface Grocery Recommendation
title_zh: 面向 Web-scale 电商的时间感知复购预测：多场景 Grocery Recommendation 的 Survival Models
abstract_en: Repurchase recommenders in e-commerce are commonly framed as a binary question asking "will this customer buy this item within W days", a formulation that requires a separately trained model for every horizon of interest. We replace this stack with survival models that predict time-to-repurchase directly, and evaluate them on millions of customers from a major grocery e-commerce platform across more than thirty ablation configurations. Our study makes three contributions. First, an empirical hazard analysis reveals a slightly decreasing marginal hazard (k ~ 0.9), differing from the common intuition that grocery items become more likely to be repurchased the longer since the last purchase (increasing hazard, k > 1). Log-Normal achieves the best marginal fit (R^2 = 0.998) and the best ranking, despite Weibull providing the best conditional residual fit, revealing an apparent discrepancy we analyze in detail. Second, a single Accelerated Failure Time (AFT) model replaces three per-horizon binary classifiers, matching or exceeding each at its own horizon while using roughly 3x fewer total trees. Feature importance reshuffles under the survival objective: channel-cadence and recency signals rise while aggregate frequency counts fall. Third, a 4-parameter parametric calibration maps raw survival CDFs to per-horizon probabilities with zero cross-horizon monotonicity violations. Calibration quality varies by an order of magnitude across the AFT family: Exponential AFT (Weibull k=1) achieves expected calibration error (ECE) ~1e-4, roughly 10x lower than Log-Normal, while ranking metrics agree within 0.3% relative. We adopt Exponential AFT for probability-consuming surfaces and Log-Normal for pure ranking, exposing a principled calibration-ranking trade-off within a single AFT family.
abstract_zh: 论文将电商复购预测从“客户是否会在 W 天内购买某商品”的多时间窗口二分类问题，改写为直接预测复购时间的 Survival Models，从而用单一模型覆盖多个预测期限。基于大型 Grocery e-commerce 平台数百万客户和 30 余组消融实验，研究发现：复购边际风险呈轻微递减趋势（k≈0.9），而非通常假设的随时间递增；Log-Normal 在边际分布拟合（R²=0.998）和排序方面最佳，但 Weibull 在条件残差拟合方面更优。单个 Accelerated Failure Time（AFT）模型可替代三个按时间窗口训练的二分类器，在各自时间窗口达到相当或更佳效果，同时总树数量约减少 3 倍。相较二分类目标，Survival objective 使 channel-cadence 和 recency 特征重要性上升，而聚合频次特征下降。研究还提出一个 4 参数的参数化校准方法，将原始 survival CDF 映射为各时间窗口概率，并保证跨窗口概率单调性。不同 AFT 分布在校准与排序之间存在明显权衡：Exponential AFT（Weibull k=1）的 ECE 约为 1e-4，比 Log-Normal 低约 10 倍，而排序指标相对差异不超过 0.3%。因此，论文建议在需要概率输入的推荐场景采用 Exponential AFT，在仅关注排序的场景采用 Log-Normal。
key_points_zh: 将多个时间窗口的复购二分类器统一为单个 Survival-based AFT 模型，模型树数量约减少 3 倍，且性能不降反升。
真实 Grocery e-commerce 数据显示，复购边际风险略呈递减（k≈0.9）；Log-Normal 最适合边际拟合与排序，Weibull 更适合条件残差拟合。
Survival objective 改变特征重要性：channel-cadence 与 recency 信号增强，聚合频次统计的重要性下降。
提出 4 参数参数化校准，将 survival CDF 转换为各预测期限的复购概率，并实现零跨期限单调性违规。
Exponential AFT 校准最佳（ECE≈1e-4），Log-Normal 排序最佳；概率消费型场景选 Exponential AFT，纯排序场景选 Log-Normal。

llm_assessment.comment: This is a strong industrially grounded e-commerce recommendation study that directly improves timing-aware repurchase prediction, calibration, and multi-surface serving efficiency.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作具有较强的工业电商背景，直接提升了时间感知的复购预测、校准能力与多场景服务效率。
